Lemma
[Rough upper bound for $H$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0366, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0367, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0368 ↗ lem:chow-iii-noncompact-heat-kernel-mass-bound 1. ch26:26.17\group Heat Kernel Upper Bounds

Under the hypotheses of the evolving-metric mean value inequality, there is $C<\infty $ such that \[ H(x,\tau ;y,v)\le \min \left\{ \frac{C}{\Vol _{\widetilde g}B_{\widetilde g}(x,\sqrt{\tau -v}/2)}, \frac{C}{\Vol _{\widetilde g}B_{\widetilde g}(y,\sqrt{\tau -v}/2)} \right\} . \]
Proof

\sketch Apply the parabolic mean value inequality at radius $\sqrt{\tau -v}/2$, then use the uniform $L^1$ bound. Apply the adjoint version for the estimate in the second variable.

□
